description: The chart illustrates the accuracy performance (in percent) of several reinforcement-learning (RL) methods, shown with and without a self-reflection variant, across three benchmarks. The horizontal axis contains the categorical benchmarks ordered left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, with no additional axis label shown; the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 62, with regularly spaced tick marks every 2 percentage points. For each benchmark, six adjacent bars are displayed, corresponding to the methods indicated by the legend: DAPO (light blue with diagonal hatching), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid medium blue), SRPO (solid salmon/orange), GRPO (light orange with diagonal hatching), PPO (teal with diagonal hatching), and PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green); the bars are grouped by benchmark with the same left-to-right method order repeated in each group, and no bars appear stacked or specially annotated beyond the hatch patterns. In the Mathverse group, the approximate accuracies are DAPO ~53.1%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56.1%, SRPO ~55.9%, GRPO ~53.4%, PPO ~53.3%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~54.5%. In the MMLU group, the bars are approximately DAPO ~55.9%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~56.9%, SRPO ~57.1%, GRPO ~55.8%, PPO ~54.6%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~56.2%. In the Physics group, the bars are approximately DAPO ~57.5%, DAPO+Self-reflection ~61.0%, SRPO ~60.6%, GRPO ~58.1%, PPO ~56.9%, and PPO+Self-reflection ~59.1%. The categories are not sorted by bar height; instead, they follow the fixed benchmark order and consistent within-group method ordering shown by the legend.
